{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicates in patient_id
patient_counts = df['patient_id'].value_counts()
duplicate_patients = patient_counts[patient_counts > 1]

# Report number of patients with multiple rows
print(f"Number of patients with multiple rows: {len(duplicate_patients)}")
print(f"Total duplicate rows: {len(df) - len(df.drop_duplicates(subset=['patient_id']))}")

# Show the sample_seq values for one such patient
duplicate_patient = duplicate_patients.index[0]
print(f"\nSample_seq values for patient {duplicate_patient}:\n{df[df['patient_id'] == duplicate_patient][['sample_seq', 'biomarker_baseline', 'biomarker_final', 'responded']]}")"}
